title: Callvale before: job status in PostgreSQL
claim: Every pipeline step updates the call's status row in PostgreSQL, and at peak the updates queue behind locks and connections.
alt: Before: the S3 upload event starts the start-job function; the pipeline functions for converting, transcribing and saving results each update the call's status row in the PostgreSQL database through RDS Proxy; the dashboard reads the same table.

edges.label: event
edges.say: An upload to Amazon S3 starts the start-job function.

edges.label: updates
edges.say: Each pipeline step updates the status row of the call in PostgreSQL.

edges.label: reads
edges.say: The dashboard reads the same status rows to list a customer's jobs.

edges.label: slow at peak
edges.say: At peak, row locks and connections slow every update.

notes: Brief 28 story pair, before (pipeline state P2); 2-deep.md#decision-record (after Context). Title, claim, alt and steps from brief.json. Story steps: no fact link, no number. Two columns.
